notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.3.1 bundles Browser CRM V4.1 and hardens the live Supabase CRM sync. Supabase remains the shared CRM source while Desktop SQLite is the local mirror/cache. Desktop writes now read the existing cloud row first so cloud-only fields such as contact name, full address, Google Maps URL, opening hours and service-area data are preserved instead of being blanked by normal Desktop edits. Pipeline drag-and-drop uses the same cloud-aware update path in Desktop and hosted/phone mode, and Sync Now is available in hosted/phone mode after Supabase sign-in. Existing two-way sync, messaging, Twilio calling, Finder, call scripts, summaries, SQLite data and updater behaviour are preserved.
